evals.prompt: Connect this application's CRM and billing MCP servers to a LangChain agent, exposing only three relevant tools per turn.
evals.expected_output: An async runtime lifespan, refresh policies, and CapabilityRoutingMiddleware from mcp_capability_router.integrations.langchain.
assertions: Imports the middleware from mcp_capability_router.integrations.langchain with limit=3
Uses on_register or explicit refresh before retrieval
Closes the runtime and scopes credentials

evals.prompt: Configure a slow server with its own timeout, safe retries, and independent quota while preserving the runtime policy.
evals.expected_output: A per-registration ResiliencePolicy made with dataclasses.replace.
assertions: Puts timeout and retry inside ResiliencePolicy
Does not retry unsafe tool calls implicitly

evals.prompt: Add read-only result caching and OpenTelemetry traces to the router without leaking tool arguments.
evals.expected_output: Router tracing with capture_tool_content=False, an application-owned tracer provider, ToolResultCache for safe reads, and application-owned cache storage.
assertions: Disables tool content capture on the router or the explicitly supplied interceptor and notes other instrumentation may record content
Caches safe reads only and documents invalidation

evals.prompt: Give our OpenAI SDK agent only the relevant MCP tools per request, and expose the same servers to Claude Desktop through one MCP endpoint.
evals.expected_output: route_tools converted to OpenAI function tools and executed with RoutedTool, plus as_mcp_server in search mode.
assertions: Uses runtime.route_tools and awaits the RoutedTool with the model arguments
Returns structured_content or text content to the model and handles router errors
Serves runtime.as_mcp_server without bypassing the runtime, behind authentication over HTTP
